comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The clock period is clamp(82.5 - 13.5*x, 15, 150) milliseconds in the fast position and clamp(325 - 150*x, 150, 500) in the slow one, where x runs -5 to 5 from the two speed knobs and the TIME CV. The four channels run at 1.3, 3.7, 5.5 and 7.9 times that period, which is what makes them drift apart. With a channel's loop switch off, each step writes a new value into a random slot of a pattern whose length is set at random between 1 and 64, and a slot is set high about one time in five. The oscillator frequency is clamp(120 + 16*x, 40, 200) in the slow position and clamp(8000 + 1400*x, 1000, 15000) in the fast one; those two upper figures are built by immediate instructions rather than stored as constants, so the line keeps to the ones that can be matched in the data. The slow-range clock period was written here as 325 - 150*x; the source gives rescale(x, -5, 5, 500, 150), which is 325 - 35*x.
